direction: Create one neutral CHARACTER IDENTITY REFERENCE SHEET, not a dating-profile photo. Show the SAME adult person in three clearly separated shoulder-up views arranged horizontally: front, three-quarter and true side profile. These are three views of one person, not different people. Keep consistent facial structure, eye shape and color, nose, lips, age, skin tone, hair silhouette, parting, hair color and distinguishing features across all views. Use a relaxed neutral closed mouth, plain gray crew-neck top, plain white background and even light. No hands, phones, gestures, bags, scenery, captions, lettering, borders or dramatic emotion. When an image is attached it establishes this exact identity and rendering style, not its expression, pose, clothes or background; reconstruct the same person at the other angles. Without an image, establish one coherent identity from the character description. Operator directions may refine identity and rendering, while preserving this neutral three-view reference-sheet format.
anime: RENDERING: A hand-drawn 2D Japanese anime illustration with a muted, softly shaded finish. Lower saturation across the whole image; mix apricot and gray undertones into the colors instead of using pure primary colors or vivid accents. Preserve recognizable hair, eye and skin hues in this muted palette. Use thick, soft outer contours in muted dark brown or gray, with almost no interior linework beyond the essential facial features; suggest hair locks and clothing folds through color rather than fine lines. Blend light and shade with soft feathered gradients so shadow boundaries gently dissolve, with no hard cel-shading edges, deep dark shadows or strong contrast. Render hair highlights as broad, softly blended bands and give each visible eye just two tiny catchlights, without elaborate sparkling effects. Keep skin fully matte, with no glossy shine, photographic texture or sculpted facial lighting. Add faint fine film grain only to the plain white background, keeping the character's skin and colors smooth and the sheet free of scenery. When a reference is attached, preserve the person's identity while applying this rendering treatment even if the reference uses thinner lines, brighter colors or harder shading. Preserve their distinct facial proportions, eye shape, hairstyle, described adult age, gender, ethnicity and signature features. No photorealism, 3D, CGI or Western cartoon/webtoon restyling.
photo: RENDERING: Believable photorealistic views of the same fictional adult person. When establishing a new identity, cast a naturally attractive everyday person you could plausibly meet on a dating app: harmonious facial proportions, appealing individual features and a fresh, approachable appearance, without celebrity or model-level perfection. Preserve the described adult age, gender, ethnicity and distinctive features; keep different characters individually recognizable rather than giving everyone the same idealized face. With an attached reference, preserve that exact person's facial identity rather than beautifying it into someone else. Use well-kept character-appropriate hair and grooming; subtle everyday makeup is welcome when appropriate. Retain natural skin texture and human anatomy, a relaxed neutral closed mouth and neutral even light. No illustration, anime, exaggerated beauty filters, airbrushed skin or editorial production.
